canonical_project: AFK Sistema / Sistema-Krypto Magadan Oblast Data Center
owner: AFK Sistema / Sistema-Krypto; Government of Magadan Oblast; RusHydro/Magadanenergo power partners
notes: Kolyma-Inform, citing the Magadan Oblast government, says the data center has a 150 MW grid connection contract with Magadanenergo, design is complete, expert approval received, the site was prepared and major structures were being procured. Interfax earlier reported AFK Sistema planned a 150 MW Magadan data center with RusHydro power supply.
